difference: method minus B*: negative is improvement
case_aggregation: mean loss within request over repeats, then mean across requests
sampling: uniform pairs cluster bootstrap; retain entire questions and actual resampled N
test: two-sided null-centered cluster bootstrap-t; no p if any degenerate draws or G < 30
calendar_rule: merge contiguous bins spanned by any complete question; retain all members
interpretation: exploratory retrospective public benchmark; conditional on fitted models and fixed runs
